text: Every indexed profile shall be fully resolved without binding-time inheritance/host defaults. Binding shall validate the exact index entry, manifest/shared-contract digests and closed schema, reject unknown IDs/fields/contracts, and record exact resolved identities. Linking shall require equality of all resolved components, including CPU/environment, until an explicit compatibility revision exists.
